_about: Where each fact came from. IMPORTANT: OpenStreetMap/Overpass was blocked by this environment's network policy (HTTP 403 from the egress proxy), and direct fetches of Wikipedia also failed. Every 'wp_*' source below was read through web-search result summaries of that article, not by opening the page. Treat them as leads to check, not as proof. That is why every data row is verified:false.

sources.title: Chamran Expressway
sources.used_for: Ends (N: Modares/Valiasr = Parkway; S: Tohid Tunnel); crossings S->N: Jalal-e Al-e Ahmad (Nasr Bridge), 'Resalat' (probably Hakim, see REVIEW), Hemmat, Niayesh (Velayat Bridge). Article content dated Aug 2007. A search summary (Chamran or Yadegar article, unclear which) says Chamran 'changes its direction to west-east near Seoul Street'.

sources.title: Modarres Expressway
sources.used_for: Ends (N: Chamran/Valiasr; S: Haft-e Tir Sq); N->S order: Sadr, Haghani, Fajr Interchange (Hemmat), Resalat.

sources.title: Kordestan Expressway
sources.used_for: N end Niayesh; passes Hemmat then Resalat/Hakim; S end Jalal-e Al-e Ahmad / Shahid Gomnam. Table labels described as unclear.

sources.title: Yadegar-e-Emam Expressway
sources.used_for: Starts at Evin, goes west a few km, turns south, ends at Azadi Avenue; N end listed as Seoul St / Chamran; crosses Niayesh, Hemmat, then Hakim. Article tagged 'multiple issues'.

sources.title: Navvab Expressway
sources.used_for: Chamran renamed after Tohid Tunnel; runs south to the Qale Morghi / Niruye Havaei junction; ~5.5 km.

sources.title: Imam Ali Expressway
sources.used_for: Ends only: N Artesh Expressway, S Avini Expressway; 'from Darabad to Ray'. No junction table found.

sources.title: Sayyad Expressway (Sayyad Shirazi)
sources.used_for: N end Babayi; N->S: Zeinoddin, Sayyad Shirazi Interchange (Resalat); S end Sepah Sq; ~10.7 km.

sources.title: Hemmat Expressway
sources.used_for: E end Pasdaran/Shariati/Zeinoddin; E->W: Haghani, Fajr (Modares), Africa Blvd, Gandhi St, Kordestan, Sheikh Bahaei/Chamran, Sheikh Fazlollah Nouri, Yadegar-e Emam, Ashrafi Esfahani. W end conflicts: infobox says Kharrazi, text says Azadegan / Tehran-Shomal Freeway.

sources.title: Hakim Expressway
sources.used_for: E end = Resalat/Kordestan junction after Resalat Tunnel; E->W: Kordestan, Sheikh Bahai, Kargar, Chamran, Sheikh Fazlollah Nouri, Yadegar-e Emam, Laleh, Ashrafi Esfahani; W end Allameh Jafari (Nour) Sq.

sources.title: Qasem Soleimani Expressway (formerly Resalat)
sources.used_for: Renamed from Resalat; W end Hakim/Kordestan, E end Yasini; ~12 km.

sources.title: Hashemi Rafsanjani Expressway (Niayesh)
sources.used_for: Official name of Niayesh; starts at Valiasr St, becomes Abshenasan after Ashrafi Esfahani interchange; passes Kordestan, Chamran, Yadegar-e Emam; E end linked to Sadr by a tunnel.

sources.title: Sadr Expressway
sources.used_for: W end Modares (Gholhak); E end Babayi / Pasdaran; ~5 km.

sources.title: Babayi Expressway
sources.used_for: W end Sadr/Pasdaran; E end Tehran-Damavand & Tehran-Parchin roads; E->W table: Niru-ye Zamini Blvd, Imam Ali, Sayyad, ..., Sadr; ~16.5 km.

sources.title: Zeinoddin Expressway
sources.used_for: E->W table: Bagheri, Imam Ali, Sayyad; continues Hemmat east of Pasdaran.

sources.title: Azadegan Expressway
sources.used_for: 'Tehran Ringway', southern Tehran; E end Basij Interchange; W end Hemmat / Tehran-Shomal Freeway; met by Sheikh Fazlollah Nouri, Allameh Jafari, Saidi (west side) and Tondguyan, Behesht-e Zahra, Raisi (south side).

sources.title: Allameh Jafari Expressway
sources.used_for: Connects the west end of Hakim to Azadi Stadium; its W end is at Azadegan.

sources.title: Milad Tower
sources.used_for: Hemmat to the north, Hakim to the south, Sheikh Fazlollah Nouri to the west, Chamran to the east; coords 35.7447 N, 51.3753 E.

sources.title: SURFIRAN mag: Tehran Milad Tower
sources.used_for: Independent confirmation of the same four bounding highways.

sources.title: Azadi Tower / Azadi Square
sources.used_for: Western entrance of Tehran; coords 35.6994 N, 51.3378 E.

sources.title: Tajrish
sources.used_for: Coords 35.8056 N, 51.4381 E (an older revision gives a point ~1 km west); ~1600 m altitude.

sources.title: Tehran railway station
sources.used_for: Coords 35.658 N, 51.398 E; located at Rah Ahan Square.

sources.title: Valiasr Street
sources.used_for: Runs from Rah Ahan (railway) Square in the south to Tajrish in the north, ~17.9 km.

sources.title: UNESCO Tentative List: Valiasr Street
sources.used_for: Rah-ahan Square ~1117 m, Tajrish Square ~1615 m: the slope from south to north.

sources.title: ویکی‌فقه: بزرگراه کردستان (تهران)
sources.used_for: Pass 2 (search summary). North-south, ~6.2 km; south start = Kordestan / Shahid Gomnam / Jalal Al-e Ahmad junction; reaches Niayesh in the north; crosses Hemmat, Hakim, Mollasadra, linked only by U-turns; north extension to Chamran under construction.

sources.title: ویکی‌فقه: بزرگراه شهید همت (تهران)
sources.used_for: Pass 2 (search summary). ~18 km east-west; east end Zeinoddin, west end Kharrazi; crosses Haghani, Modares, Chamran.

sources.title: ویکی‌فقه: بزرگراه یادگار امام (تهران)
sources.used_for: Pass 2 (search summary). ~16 km from Seoul St (north) to Hashemi St (south-west); ~6 km east-west to Farahzad valley, ~10 km north-south.

sources.title: ویکی‌فقه: پارک وی (تهران)
sources.used_for: Pass 2 (search summary). Chamran (old name Parkway) starts at the Parkway bridge as continuation of Modares and ends at Tohid Square; Tohid Tunnel joins Navvab Safavi.

sources.title: Wikidata: Tohid Tunnel
sources.used_for: Pass 2 (search summary). Tunnel ~2.1 km carrying Chamran and Navvab.

sources.title: Persian pages on Imam Ali Expressway (fa.wikipedia / wikifeqh / mrestate)
sources.used_for: Pass 2 (search summary). Lists Babaei, Zeinoddin (Hemmat extension), Resalat, Mahallati, Besat, Azadegan, Azadegan Park, Shahr-e Rey as roads Imam Ali crosses. The summary did not say which of the pages listed it, so treat as unattributed.

sources.title: AARoads wiki: Resalat Expressway
sources.used_for: Pass 2 (search summary, truncated). East-to-west list names Imam Ali Expressway.

sources.title: Hamshahri: Hemmat exits list
sources.used_for: Pass 2 (search summary, undated). Exits west to east: Pazhuhesh, Peykan-shahr, Olympic Village, Jannatabad, Sattari, Ashrafi Esfahani, Yadegar-e Emam, Milad Tower, Sheikh Fazlollah.

sources.title: Abadis: Ayatollah Sadr Expressway
sources.used_for: Pass 2 (search summary). Says Sadr starts in the east at the junction of Imam Ali and Babaei, which conflicts with en-wiki (east end at Pasdaran).
